root_cause.text: The function `nsim_dev_trap_skb_build` allocated and placed an IP header into a dummy sk_buff using `skb_put`, which does not zero the allocated memory, leaving most fields of the `iphdr` struct uninitialized and exposing uninitialized kernel heap data when the packet is processed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `skb_put` to `skb_put_zero` to guarantee zero initialization of the whole IP header, fixing the KMSAN uninit-value reported by syzbot from `nsim_dev_trap_skb_build`. The original code only explicitly set `protocol`, `saddr`, and `daddr` fields, leaving other fields (e.g., version, IHL, tos, tot_len, id, frag_off, ttl, check) uninitialized.
